prompt: Generate a transparent 2 by 2 sprite sheet of four consistent Windows utility toolbar icons, matching dark navy rounded outlines, cyan/light blue fill, gold accents and restrained dimensional shading of the existing Pokémon OCR helper toolbar. Top left: settings gear. Top right: cancel X. Bottom left: download arrow into tray. Bottom right: open folder. Center each simple pictogram in its equal cell with generous transparent margins. No text, grid, tile backgrounds, watermark or extra symbols. Legible at 24 pixels.
conversion: Equal cell extraction and ICO resampling of the imagegen output, preserving alpha.
